name: Waveshare ESP32-S3 Touch LCD 3.5B-C

touch.notes: Touch controller unverified on the exact 3.5B-C SKU: the Waveshare wiki describes the AXS15231B as an integrated LCD+touch controller (QSPI display / I2C touch), so do not assert FT6336 - verify against the Waveshare wiki on physical hardware before driver acceptance. Touch is navigation-only and never approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: The large 3.5 inch 320x480 display is why this board is the premium reference of the curated ESP32-S3-Touch wallet family (esp32_usb_nip46, nSealr Key).

camera.pinout_status: 3.5B-C selected; verify camera pinout on physical hardware before driver acceptance
camera.notes: The case-plus-OV5640 3.5B-C SKU carries an onboard OV5640 camera; the USB wallet firmware does not use it. The camera fields are retained as a hardware fact and to keep the cross-repo hardware QR-requirements alignment stable until the hardware repo is re-scoped in a later phase.

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware approval model after exact SKU validation; touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware rejection model after exact SKU validation.

wireless_policy: Wireless must be disabled or excluded in high-assurance QR vault builds; no Wi-Fi or BLE path may participate in signing approval.
debug_policy: Debug access stays enabled for board bring-up and must be locked before any production-key experiment.
production_signing: disabled until exact case-plus-OV5640 SKU, camera, display, physical controls, storage, provisioning, and signing tests pass
reference_notes: Premium reference board of the curated Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch wallet family for the universal esp32_usb_nip46 firmware (nSealr Key). Retagged from the retired secondary ESP32 QR-vault framing.
The confirmed implementation SKU is ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5B-C, with AXS15231B/QSPI display work pending.
Camera fields are retained for cross-repo hardware QR-requirements alignment; the USB wallet firmware does not use the onboard camera.
